text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(5 sets of bench presses done...! Phew, 
I'm sooooo tired...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Crap, I'm already dizzy on my feet... 
Need a break――wait, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Nnnnghhhhh...!!!! Haaah――!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (――Are those two STILL at it?!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(She was already goin' at it before I even 
got here!! Just how long is she plannin' 
to keep pushin' herself...?!）

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Gaaah……! Tracewen Academy really is an 
insane place, huh...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Agh, screw it, can't be helped! I'll show 
'em I've still got plenty in the tank...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ――Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, that Trainer is looking this way! 
Did they realize I'm totally wiped 
out...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Trainer. Thanks for all your 
hard work.
choice_data_list:
Good work. Amazing how calm and composed 
you stayed!

Good work. Amazing how calm and composed 
you stayed!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, they haven't noticed me?! ――Hell 
yeah!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you, I'm truly honored by your 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Right... Shall we finish things off with 
this next?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Since I'm already at it, might as well 
show 'em I can keep goin' all day...!)
choice_data_list:
Try doing it with the image of slowly 
spreading it out!
Looks like it'll build up back muscles...!

Looks like a great workout for the back 
muscles...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Since I'm already at it, might as well 
show 'em I can keep goin' all day...!)
choice_data_list:
Try doing it with the image of slowly 
spreading it out!
Looks like it'll build up back muscles...!

Looks like a great workout for the back 
muscles...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, some advice. Let's put that to good 
use, then—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gonna break past my limits!! Here 
goes――HAAAAAHHHH――!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Haa, haa, haa... What the heck is this?! 
It's brutal~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Talk about lucky not messin' up...! Did a 
bloody good job!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Right?! I worked super hard, y'know! For 
real for real...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(They totally get it! Exactly, I gotta 
build up my back muscles to stabilize my 
running form.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My, just as expected of you, Trainer. You 
are completely right. —Now then, let us 
begin.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Phew, haaaaah―――― ...Ah)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRRAAAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (――NO WAY IN HELL!! I dropped it...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aye. I ain't hurt none, so I'm grand. 
Sorry for givin' ya a fright.
choice_data_list:
Just in case, let me teach you some 
recovery stretches.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Gaaah……! The exhaustion finally caught up 
with me! I totally blew lookin' cool at 
the very end~...!)
